description: Put the business's own logo, colour and domain on the pages made for its calls, and choose which sites may embed them. from_website: true reads the logo and colour off the business's own homepage for anything not given. color is a hex like #0f766e (too-light colours are refused); null clears back to the default. Requires an admin of the business. Pages already sent pick it up on their next load.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

color.description: Hex colour like #0f766e, or null for the default

embed_origins.description: https sites allowed to embed the pages, e.g. https://www.example.com. Empty list = only the business's own website.

from_website.description: Fill logo and colour from the business's website

logo_url.description: https link to the logo, or null to clear

page_domain.description: The business's own subdomain for its call pages, e.g. calls.example.com, or "auto" to use calls. on the domain it already sends email from (else its website). Kai adds the DNS record itself where it can; otherwise the reply names the DNS provider and the exact records. New links use the domain only once a real request to it reaches KaiCalls. Texts to callers keep the kaicalls.com link. null removes it and links go back to kaicalls.com.

name: set_page_branding
title: Set Call Page Branding
